$comment: Annotated real-world Merlin Option. Adapted from the 'DKMODE' cheat code registered in haxcms-cheat-codes.js and the 'Dark Mode Toggle' option registered in haxcms-site-editor-ui.js firstUpdated(). This is a STATIC option — selecting it fires a single CustomEvent and closes the palette. The `shortcut` field (inline descriptor form) links the option to the shared KeyboardShortcutManager registry; defineOption() resolves it to shortcutLabel='Ctrl⇧D'. The registry-id-string form (e.g. "shortcut": "cms-save") is shown in the README minimal sample. Compare with example-program.json for the dynamic variant.
title: DKMODE

value.$comment: For eventName 'super-daemon-element-method', the runtime calls value.target[value.method](...value.args). Here it invokes editorInstance._executeCheatDKMODE().
